changelog: Train: the driver is reliably seated in the cab after spawning (retries while the networked train settles) and put back aboard if ejected.
Train: the right train variation is now detected automatically on every game build (metro was spawning as a freight config on recent builds), all carriage models are preloaded.
New Neo-Brutalist Pop UI across every screen (agency, service selector, HUD, objective banner, briefing, mini-games, editor).
Train: mission trains now spawn reliably (train system enabled before CreateMissionTrain, F8 logs on failure).
No more flickering UI: HUD and objective banner update smoothly without flashing or replaying their animation.
Train: metro and freight trains spawn reliably again (start area is streamed in first, missing carriage models are skipped).
Readable debug mode: short point names, per-kind colours/markers, text only up close and for the nearest site.
Gas station: customer cars actually drive to the pump (re-task when stuck, discreet fallback).
Gas station: single 'serve the customer' action on the customer's pump only, with arrow and GPS on the car; fuel grade picked automatically.
Anti-cheat compatibility: tow mission car and train are authorized before spawning; tow customer ped is local.
Car wash: easier roof hits, ground-snapped markers, no leaked floating view prop.
Ground-snapped peds, props, victims, boards and mission vehicles across all jobs.
Full cleanup on duty end, death and resource restart (vehicles, cams, fx, peds, timecycle).
Server hardening: server-verified payouts, job-only vehicle authorization, validated admin saves, fixed duty-end throttle.
NUI fixes: missing labels, farmer cards, lighter HUD, editor keeps state on save, layout at 1280/2560, minigame key handling.
Reworked default keys to avoid conflicts (gas station, farmer, metal detector).
Press E at the farmer's equipment shed to open the vehicle selection menu without targeting an empty zone.
Static job interactions now follow their configured positions after moving points in debug mode.
Fixed vehicle spawn authorization failing when the anti-cheat export is unavailable.
Fixed the car wash camera native so its view opens and closes correctly.
Immersive car wash camera view: clean directly on the vehicle without walking around on foot.
Smooth mouse aiming with on-screen tools (lance, foam cannon, microfiber, buffer, vacuum) aligned with your view.
Dynamic vantage controls: Z (Hood/Front), S (Rear), Q (Left), D (Right), SPACE (Roof) and R (Wheels cycle).
All wash stages integrated: foam, rinse, drying, panel polishing and cabin vacuuming with automatic door opening.
Realistic dirt scaling on arrival: full wash arrives blackened in heavy dirt, quick wash arrives moderately dusty.
